description: Empirical scaling factor applied to xfp_rp3_sigma to reach ~50% coverage on the per-start backtest panel (3,229 starts, 2021-2025). Without it, p25-p75 covers only 21.6% of actual outcomes (~2.3x too tight). Derived in sigma_recalibration.md (2026-06-03).
rationale_for_global: Tier-specific alphas span 2.36-2.55 (~8% range). Tier-specific coverage 51-53% per tier vs 49-54% with global rescale — no meaningful improvement. Global is the simpler choice that passes the 45-55% coverage gate in every tier.
asymmetry_note: Residuals are slightly asymmetric (mean +0.32, q25=-4.6, q75=+6.5 pooled). Approach A keeps Gaussian symmetric bands for simplicity; consumers should know upside tails are slightly fatter.
